classification.difficultyReason: Plot and join the given vertices, then obtain image coordinates by subtracting four from y and reflecting the resulting points in the y-axis.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Plot the points $A$, $B$ and $C$ and draw the triangle $ABC$.

answer.short: Triangle with vertices $A(3,1)$, $B(7,1)$ and $C(7,4)$, joined as shown.
answer.worked: Plot $A(3,1)$, $B(7,1)$ and $C(7,4)$ on labelled axes. Join $AB$, $BC$ and $CA$.

spec.description: Complete solution plot with unit grid, labelled axes and the three joined vertices.
spec.mathematics: A=(3,1), B=(7,1), C=(7,4); edges AB, BC and CA.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the coordinates of the vertices of the image of the triangle under a translation of 4 units down followed by a reflection in the $y$-axis.

answer.worked:
First translate 4 units down: keep each $x$-coordinate and subtract 4 from each $y$-coordinate.
$$\begin{align*}A'&=(3,1-4)\\A'&=(3,-3)\\B'&=(7,1-4)\\B'&=(7,-3)\\C'&=(7,4-4)\\C'&=(7,0)\end{align*}$$
Then reflect in the $y$-axis: change the sign of each $x$-coordinate and keep each $y$-coordinate.
$$\begin{align*}A''&=(-3,-3)\\B''&=(-7,-3)\\C''&=(-7,0)\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Original triangle, dashed intermediate translated triangle and solid final reflected triangle; unit grid and labelled axes. Intermediate labels correct the teacher answer's printed C-prime error.
